{{Top|leg}}
'''Tabrex''' was a [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Part of [[Katha Niar]]'s team send to [[Makeb]] to secure its reserves of [[Isotope-5]], Tabrex accompanied [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Cytharat]] in his assault on the [[Stronghold One]]. During the mission, Tabrex was killed by the [[InterStellar Regulators]].
